record.original_question: Consider a 4-manifold endowed with a codimension-1 foliation F . Suppose moreover that there is a plane field ξ ⊂ T F that is a leafwise contact structure. Assume that ξ splits as a sum of line fields. Can this data be perturbed to an Engel structure?

evidence.quote: Question 2.17. Consider a 4-manifold endowed with a codimension-1 foliation F . Suppose moreover that there is a plane field ξ ⊂ T F that is a leafwise contact structure. Assume that ξ splits as a sum of line fields. Can this data be perturbed to an Engel structure?

artifact.status_search_result: The question concerning whether a leafwise contact structure inside a codimension-1 foliation on a 4-manifold, equipped with a splitting into line fields, can be perturbed to an Engel structure appears in current research on Engel geometry and is listed among open problems on Engel structures. No published resolution was located; the existence problem of Engel structures has been settled (Vogel) but this specific perturbation question with the splitting hypothesis appears unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Engel structures (AimPL open problem list)
status_evidence.snippet: Open problems on Engel structures, including questions about perturbation of leafwise contact structures within foliations.
status_evidence.claim: Related perturbation questions about Engel structures appear on the AIM open-problem list, suggesting the problem is open.

status_evidence.title: Existence of Engel structures (Vogel)
status_evidence.snippet: Existence of Engel structures on parallelizable 4-manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of Engel structures is established in general, but specific perturbation questions from leafwise contact data with line-field splitting are not addressed.
